input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
input.rationale: The Agreement renews automatically for successive 1-year terms (renewal term length is compliant), but there is no non-renewal mechanic: our only route out of a renewal is the mutual "for any reason" right exercisable on ninety (90) days' written notice after the Initial Term. A 90-day exit window fails the fallback requirement of a non-renewal notice window of no more than 60 days and sits at the walk-away boundary. We therefore added a Customer-only non-renewal election exercisable on at least 60 days' written notice before the end of the then-current Term (stated in numerals for clarity), leaving Kubient's 90-day notice right and the paragraph 4(b) breach/insolvency mechanics unchanged so we do not shorten our own protection. The price-cap element is not engaged: renewal carries the same terms with no unilateral price-increase or uplift mechanic (fees are a revenue share set in each Exhibit). This sits at the fallback ceiling; we should not accept any window beyond 60 days.

proposal.summary: Add a Customer non-renewal notice right on 60 days' notice
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement auto-renews for 1-year terms and our only exit is the mutual 90-day post-Initial-Term notice, so we have added a Customer non-renewal election exercisable on 60 days' written notice before the end of the then-current Term, consistent with our fallback position of a non-renewal window of no more than 60 days. Kubient's 90-day notice right is untouched.

ops.text: Customer may elect not to renew this Agreement by giving Kubient written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the then-current Term, in which case this Agreement will expire at the end of that Term.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
